soundness_flags.label: ass:center-interior
soundness_flags.one_line: A uniform positive lower bound on every latent four-state transition cell is load-bearing for residual broadcast but the justification invokes observed nonzero cells, which do not establish this unobserved conditional-transition condition in ACCT-type survival data.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 5: simultaneous region inversion
soundness_flags.one_line: If the true margins are incompatible for every d≤barδκ, then δsignall=+∞ by its empty-infimum definition but the true p is removed from D1−αall; the claimed coverage at a true +∞ radius therefore fails.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper identifies principal causal effects through homogeneity across trials, requires at least three trials for its local-identifiability condition, and proposes Bayesian-hierarchical sensitivity analysis for departures from homogeneity.
Theorem 2.1 characterizes the sharp region through support-function domination over directions.

source_verification_receipts.version: Review of Economic Studies 78(4), 2011 public author version
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper characterizes a multiple-equilibrium identified set by capacity-core inclusion, finite inequalities, and combinatorial checks.

The paper studies a prior study with surrogate and outcome, a new study with only the surrogate, and classes of conditional-mean functions deviating from the prior study to define resilience measures.

Theorem 1 gives sharp nonparametric sensitivity bounds on stratum means under treatment ignorability, latent principal ignorability sensitivity, and non-monotonicity; Corollary 1 bounds conditional PCEs.

The paper gives bootstrap calibrated projection confidence intervals with uniform asymptotic coverage for smooth functions in moment-(in)equality models and an approximate nonlinear optimization algorithm.
The paper bootstraps randomly perturbed LP value functions for uniformly valid inference on linear functionals or scalar subvectors defined by linear moment inequalities.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Repair the inversion theorem by defining the sign-radius target only conditional on compatibility at some d≤barδκ, or enlarge D1−αall to include +∞ whenever the profiled margins are incompatible throughout that radius range; then prove coverage separately for the incompatibility and no-crossing branches.

Replace the all-entry latent center floor with the weakest scientifically elicitable condition needed for denominator positivity and residual gluing, and give an ACCT-relevant calibration or sensitivity analysis showing when it is credible.

Demote the separation oracle and zero-drift reduction to supporting results and make the field headline the sharp multi-trial PSACE/sign-radius object with an explicit comparison to standard single-trial principal-strata bounds.

recommended_next_step: Reject this version for the false extended-real coverage claim; regenerate around a compatibility-aware confidence target and a defensible latent-support condition before advancing to Stage 0.
